description: This file declares external API functions related to the Trunk Manager and its associated protocols for the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) component. It provides function prototypes for creating various protocol-specific handlers such as IP, TCP, UDP, ESP, AH, and IP compression within the system.

methods.name: AnscCreateTrunkManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new Trunk Manager instance, given an owner context handle.

methods.name: AnscCreateTmoIp4
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to an IPv4 protocol handler within the Trunk Manager, given an owner context handle.

methods.name: AnscCreateTmoTcp
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a TCP protocol handler within the Trunk Manager, given an owner context handle.

methods.name: AnscCreateTmoUdp
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a UDP protocol handler within the Trunk Manager, given an owner context handle.

methods.name: AnscCreateTmoEsp
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to an ESP protocol handler within the Trunk Manager, given an owner context handle.

methods.name: AnscCreateTmoAh
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to an AH protocol handler within the Trunk Manager, given an owner context handle.

methods.name: AnscCreateTmoIpcomp
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to an IP compression handler within the Trunk Manager, given an owner context handle.
